plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate.
Buy MSFT at 5% as a top-quality name with a strong scanner read.
This plan aims for capital preservation and low drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and maintaining a diversified, high-quality portfolio. Expect lower volatility and smaller drawdowns.

plan: For risk-first growth, trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce leverage.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate.
Buy SMCI at 4% as a quality tech name with a strong scanner read.
This plan balances broad index, quality tech, and limited leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It maintains some exposure to leveraged ETFs while reducing overall concentration. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns compared to aggressive strategies.

plan: For aggressive growth, add to SOXL to 7%, SPAL to 6%, MUU to 6%, and METU to 6% to lean into leverage.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate.
Buy SMCI at 6% and add to CRWD at 4% as high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in strong setups for higher potential returns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdowns, daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs, and the risk of substantial losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: To park cash for yield, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Sell high-beta single names CRWD and SNOW to zero.
Add to QQQI to 30% for steady monthly distributions.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and high-beta holdings in favor of income-generating ETFs. While aiming for steady distributions, remember these are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
